verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I, the Lord of sea and sky
I have heard my people cry

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All who dwell in dark and sin
My hand will save

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I who made the stars of night
I will make their darkness bright

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Who will bear my light to them?
Whom shall I send?

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Here I am, Lord
Is it I, Lord?

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: I have heard you calling in the night

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
I will go, Lord
If you lead me

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines: I will hold your people in my heart

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I, the Lord of snow and rain
I have borne my people's pain

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I have wept for love of them
They turn away

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
I will break their hearts of stone
Give them hearts for love alone

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
I will speak my word to them
Whom shall I send?

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
I, the Lord of wind and flame
I will tend the poor and lame

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
I will set a feast for them
My hand will save

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
Finest bread I will provide
Till their hearts be satisfied

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines:
I will give my life to them
Whom shall I send?
